stations.name: Wadala Road
stations.position_source: override: No station element in OSM, but its four platforms are mapped ('Vadala Road (Harbour Line)', ways 236381659-236381661); the station is placed at their centre.

stations.name: Panvel
stations.position_source: override: Harbour and Trans-Harbour trains terminate in bay platforms beside the main station; both OSM Panvel elements (the long-distance station and the suburban station area) sit 100 m or more off those tracks, so the station is placed at the bay platforms' buffer stops.
